hook_text: From a plate of pap to a pounding drum, one idea links the whole term: energy. Ready to follow it?
clip_script: Term 3 energy trail! Tuck shop: food is fuel. Garden: plants catch sunlight, so all food energy comes from the Sun. Sun, grass, zebra, lion: the arrows point to the eater. Kitchen: kettle, electricity in, heat out. Gas and wood store energy. Music room: blow, beat, pluck, something vibrates, sound comes out. Bigger vibrations: louder. Faster vibrations: higher. And at the gate? Protect your ears from noise. Energy and Change: sorted!
visual_style: Whiteboard energy trail around a school, with stops at the tuck shop, the garden, the kitchen, the music room and the gate by the road, each showing one big idea.
mood: Upbeat and confident, like a treasure trail with every clue solved.
pacing: Five quick stops, each with its key facts and one common mistake, then the pocket summary.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw a food chain and an input-output diagram from memory.
